items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: Ben Brown, the bass player, he’s on the first floor, I gave him the gig as the copyist. So he’d be coming up on the elevator and taking the next page of the score that I’d be writing.

ctx.x: But I’ve had some professional gigs like Bob Cranshaw once, he did a Latin Christmas record. So he calls me on a Friday night and the record date is Sunday. And Ben Brown, the bass player, he’s on the first floor, I gave him the gig as the copyist. So he’d be coming up on the elevator and taking the next page of the score that I’d be writing. But we did get the gig done. But again, I started with a germ. Basically my approach is composition and arranging are the same thing. Composition is basically arranging with…
You don’t need the piano to get the germ?
